title: PAY FOR IT! 5/5 Starssssss
body: I’ve been using it to track my daily life, my daily routine, everything basic and mundane in my life like eating and drinking water! i just forget about it, or making my steps to keep a healthy lifestyle as i suffer from pcos! and even though i have a lot of time with the app i still look forward to closing my rings, it’s a game but at the same time it benefits my health and my routine is now determined!!! It reminds you every day at the times you program it, and you know yourself and whether or not the are helping, so give it a try! it’s a 100% worth it!
author: gabycguzman

title: Best Habit-Tracker on the AppStore
body: I’ve tried a few other habit trackers before this one but once I downloaded it I knew this was the right one. I’m a very fan of charts, I do prefer to see my progress more tangible and this apps delivers exactly what I want. The best part? Its incredible price.
